spec.title: Live gap rules translated to percent of price (NQ, ES)
spec.hypothesis: The live gap rules are fixed in points, so they mean very different things in 2015 (NQ ~4,500, ES ~2,100) than now (NQ ~29,000, ES ~7,700). If the gap-continuation effect is proportional to price, the same rules expressed in percent should behave consistently across 2015-2023, where the point-based rules failed.

rules.signal: gap = open of 08:30 ET bar minus prior 23:45 ET close, as % of prior close; trade in gap direction (continuation)
rules.exit: stop, target, or 16:00 ET, whichever first
rules.filter: none (unfiltered variant only; volume variant would be a separate registered test)

parameters.translation_basis: live point rules divided by the 2026-10-23 close (NQ 29175, ES 7672.5), rounded to 2 decimals, frozen, NOT tuned

spec.author: claude

pass_criteria.per_symbol: net profit factor >= 1.3 on 2015-2023 AND positive net in both 2015-2020 and 2021-2023 AND >= 100 trades
pass_criteria.supported: at least one symbol meets per_symbol, with no re-tuning
pass_criteria.not_supported: otherwise; result recorded in the log either way

spec.notes: 2024+ data is treated as seen (live rules were built on it). RTY is not used. Costs stay in fixed points/dollars so cost drag is realistic as price rises.

spec.title: Live volume-filtered YM gap rule on a MINI contract, formal scorecard 2015-2023
spec.hypothesis: The YM gap rule with the opening-bar volume filter (>= 1.2x trailing 20-day average) has a gross edge of roughly 10 points per trade. On a micro (MYM, $0.50/pt) the project's $4.50 commission wipes it out; on a mini (YM, $5/pt) cost per trade is about 1.9 points, so the edge may survive. This test puts that on the full 7-check scorecard, including the Deflated Sharpe Ratio.

rules.signal: gap = 08:30 ET bar open minus prior day's last close, in points; trade in gap direction (continuation); only if 08:30 bar volume >= 1.2x trailing 20-day average of 08:30 bar volume
rules.exit: stop, target or 16:00 ET, whichever first (stop checked before target within a bar)

spec.author: claude
spec.disclosure: Not a blind test. results/cost_sensitivity_output.txt (Entry 81) already showed this slice at about net PF 1.36 on mini. The 1.2x threshold was also chosen after seeing 2024+ data. What this test adds is the formal scorecard, a trial-adjusted Deflated Sharpe Ratio, and the sub-period split. It is NOT new out-of-sample evidence; only forward paper data and RTY can be that.

pass_criteria.conditions: net PF >= 1.3 after default costs on 2015-2023, AND net total positive in BOTH 2015-2020 and 2021-2023, AND >= 100 trades
pass_criteria.supported: all conditions met AND scorecard Check 7 (Deflated Sharpe Ratio) passes
pass_criteria.inconclusive: conditions met but the Deflated Sharpe Ratio fails (edge not distinguishable from luck given ~95 trials)

spec.title: Validation of discovery candidate: 12-month time-series momentum (skip last month), monthly rebalance
spec.hypothesis: 12-month time-series momentum (skip last month), monthly rebalance. Picked from the 240-candidate discovery search (results/discovery/20261028-200235) because it passed all filters on 2011-2019 (survivors cluster in slow trend). If the tendency is real it should keep a positive net Sharpe on 2020-2023 data it never saw.

rules.definition: exactly discovery candidate tsmom_L252_skip21_rebalM as implemented in src/research/discover.py (committed)
rules.sizing: 10% target vol per market / 60-day realized vol, 3x leverage cap, divided by active markets, one-day lag
rules.evaluation: net returns 2020-01-01..2023-12-31 only; signals use earlier data for warm-up

spec.author: claude-validation-drafter
spec.disclosure: Chosen BECAUSE it ranked well on discovery (selection from 240). Validation data was not used for the choice. Daily history for RTY only starts 2017-07; CL's 2020-04-20 negative price day is masked (hides that real move). Four validation years are short: an INCONCLUSIVE reading is the likely outcome even for a real edge.

pass_criteria.conditions: validation net Sharpe >= 0.3 AND validation cumulative net return > 0
pass_criteria.supported: conditions met AND validation Deflated Sharpe Ratio >= 0.95 (num_trials = 3)
